brief_description: GHDL-emitted GHW from an in-house VHDL-2008 testbench exercising the VHDL-specific richness the GHW format carries and VCD/FST do not: the 9-value std_logic system (incl. 'Z'/'L'/'H'), an enumeration (state_t), integer/natural, unsigned, a std_logic_vector array (mem), and a record (pix). Closes WaveCrux's previously zero GHW coverage. Regenerate via tool/ghw_fixtures/regen.sh.
anchors: root scopes include the VHDL libraries standard, std_logic_1164, numeric_std alongside wavecrux_vhdl_types_tb
tri is high-impedance ('z') initially then driven '1'; weak is weak-low ('l') then weak-high ('h')
VHDL array mem flattens to mem.[0..3] (8-bit each); record pix flattens to pix.r/g/b (4-bit each)
enum state_t is a 2-bit signal cycling IDLE/LOAD/RUN/DONE
